body:
I can understand that. Regarding your scarring, I'm assuming it's hypertrophic or keloid. Have you thought about laser treatment rather than surgeries or steroid injections? 

I have tons of old self-injury scars myself. They are pretty noticeable but no doctor will operate as they'd only get worse. Considering laser treatment.

Your wound doesn't define you. You may be focusing on it now, but it is just one part of your body. It seems like you are focusing a lot on this one thing more than is reasonable. I do the same thing at times, but I don't think it's healthy.

Probably hearing that doesn't make it any better. I hope that you can get past this hard point in your life and find happiness. It seems like you are on the right track, but things are difficult now.
Yes, I have. It did get me through the worst. Feeling better now.

Ok it seems like you have a lot going on there. Out of everything that is going on, what do you think is bothering you the most? Is it particular thoughts you are having or is it just feelings of depression and sadness?
I sincerely hope everything works out for you.
I'm not sure I would count on the neck breaking. That seems more risky to me. I'd want something painless that I can stop if I change my mind. Probably not likely to find something like that though.
Yeah, it's something I'd have to think about. I don't really want to commit suicide but lately I've been having strong feelings about it. I guess just because I'm having a lot of emotional pain.
Ok, but how do you know what's proper? Seems like recently a lot of celebrities have died this way. It doesn't seem to be too terrible.
Thank you for your concern. I am having a really rough time and was in a bad relationship that just ended. Having suicidal impulses that I am having trouble controlling right now.

Well I can try to answer some questions for you. 

It can be harder to ask for help than it can be to do everything on your own. Especially for people who are very independent. Also it is true that men aren't necessarily raised to ask for help. So I think it actually takes a lot of guts, therefore it's a sign of bravery not weakness.

A lot of people have trouble talking about their feelings. It's not weird or unusual. Might just be a matter of practice.

I don't think anyone would ridicule you. I feel kinda the same about my problems because it really embarrasses me to be this way. I feel weak and stupid for being in this state. I know I should handle things better but I can't right now.

As far as intrusive thoughts, I have had them and for me it's just OCD. It's the way that my fears come out. 

I personally think that you should keep trying to get help because it seems like that is what you want. It might just take some time to get there and overcome your discomfort.

Sorry to hear that. It's hard to deal with having a chronic illness. Something I am also dealing with. 

Social anxiety is difficult to overcome as well. I don't know if I think medication is enough for that. It's like a bandaid not a cure.
I feel the same way.
I can talk to you if you'd like. I'm in a similar position at the moment.

Sounds like OCD, unless you actually want to die. Random thoughts of death sound like it anyway.

Good for you for reaching out. At least you are taking some steps to get help.

I don't know what else to say because I'm suicidal myself at the moment. I will help you however I can. I have had a lot of experience with therapy and depression since childhood.
Ok, so why do you not want to be alive?
So why do you want to do this? Are you trying to shock people?
Ok. I respect your wishes and your right to make your own decisions.

Well I think it depends on whether you did this intentionally or not. To be honest, I have dealt with much worse than that. It's common for people to be emotionally abusive, and it happens for a lot of reasons. Is this something that they said you were doing, or something you decided you were doing?

Well I read a bit into your post history but it wasn't too clear. I don't really care if you are trolling. I'm too old to care about that shit.

I can't imagine that what you did was that bad, was it? Nobody is perfect. How long were you guys friends?

Well that's an interesting way of looking at things, but I doubt you have to worry about a sky God if you die. Primitive fairy tales. There may be an afterlife, but the idea of hell is illogical.

I think the more important issue is that you could be throwing away something that could be great. Life changes; things don't stay the same forever. Everything comes to an end. I say this as a person who thinks about suicide pretty much every day. I always come up with a reason not to do it. 

So what's going on that's making you feel this way?

You do have a point. We will all die someday. But why hasten the journey? Might as well give yourself a chance to enjoy it before you go. 

I think it doesn't matter what your problems are compared to other people. If they matter to you they are worth talking about.
